**🎉 Exciting News: Joining the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee! 🎉**

I’m thrilled to share that I’ve been invited to join the **CDS Hooks Project Management Committee**—a fantastic opportunity to help shape the future of this powerful standard that I’ve been working with since **2017**!

CDS Hooks has come a long way, enabling seamless clinical decision support at the point of care, and I’m excited to contribute to its evolution. Whether it’s refining the spec, fostering adoption, or supporting new implementations, I’m ready to help move the standard forward.

**Are you using CDS Hooks already?**
If so, please add your implementation to the [CDS Hooks Availability Wiki](https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability)—it’s a great way to showcase your work and help others learn from your experience!

**Not using CDS Hooks yet?**
I’d love to help! As a **freelance consultant**, I can assist with implementation, integration, and best practices to get your system up and running smoothly. Let’s connect and explore how CDS Hooks can enhance your clinical workflows.

Here’s to the next chapter of CDS Hooks—let’s build something amazing together! 🚀

#CDSHooks #HealthTech #ClinicalDecisionSupport #Interoperability #HealthIT #FreelanceConsulting
